generic_domain.justification: Among the given domains, 'Robust Optimization' is the broadest and most comprehensive. It deals with making decisions that are resilient to uncertainty and variations in the parameters of a problem. The other domains such as 'Adaptive Robust Optimization,' 'Distributionally Robust Optimization,' and 'Robust Generalization' all fall under this umbrella. Adaptive versions are specific methods within Robust Optimization, while Distributional robustness refers to handling uncertainties with known distributions. Robust Generalization can be seen as applying principles of robust optimization in the context of model generalization, often in machine learning.
